title: Search index
description: web/public/data/names.json: the rows of names/places.csv that are on the map, each with its names and where it lies. `frasch build index` writes it (frasch/searchindex.py, an entry in frasch/placenames.py), the web app fetches it once for the search and the place card (web/src/names.ts). A value that would be empty is left out, except `name_de`.

places.description: One entry per place, in places.csv order.

built_from.description: What the file was built from (frasch/provenance.py): each input file by a fixed label and its git blob hash, and the OSM extracts. The tiles carry the same stamp, and the web app warns when the two differ.

extracts.description: The extracts the places were located in, in the order read.

additionalProperties.description: An input file, e.g. `places.csv`: its git blob hash.

extract.description: An OSM extract, as a stamp records it.

replication_timestamp.description: How current its data is: the `osmosis_replication_timestamp` of its header. Empty for an extract without one.

place.description: One place: a row of the name list, at the first OSM object of its `osm` cell.

id.description: The row's `id`, e.g. `naibel`: stable across edits to the list and to OSM alike. The tiles carry it as `frasch:ref`.

osm.description: The row's `osm` cell: its OSM references, `node/240042766` or `way/1; node/2`, or `local/<slug>` for a place OSM does not have.

names.description: The dialect names by registry tag, `{"frr-x-mooring": "Naibel"}`: only the dialects that have one.

local.description: The name the people of the place itself use (the tiles' `frasch:local`): the name list's, else OSM's `name:frr` where the place lies in a dialect area.

dialect.description: The registry tag of the dialect area the place lies in, e.g. `frr-x-fering`; left out outside the areas.

variety.description: The sub-dialect remark on the local name, e.g. `Foortuftinge`.

name_nds.description: The Low Saxon name: OSM's `name:nds` of the place's object. The label chain falls back to it before German.

name_de.description: The German name: the primary name of the row's `de` cell, which the tiles carry as `name:de`. Empty for the few rows without one.

name_osm.description: The generic name: OSM's plain `name` of the place's object, the label chain's step near its end. Usually the German name, north of the border the Danish one.

name_da.description: The Danish name: the primary name of the row's `da` cell.
